verdict.rationale: Zulip exposes a full REST/OpenAPI API and a scriptable CLI (zulip-send) that could be used to programmatically act on many messages/topics, and offers org-wide export/import tools that operate on all data at once. However, there is no direct documentation of dedicated bulk-action endpoints (e.g., mass move/delete/tag) for an AI agent to invoke, so support is inferred rather than demonstrated.
